newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures cut gains, bounce back.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures cut gains, bounce back.

text.p: July 22 - U.S. debt futures cut their gains then bounced and Sept T-bond posted a fresh session high at 114-15/32 amid Humphrey-Hawkins headlines. Eurodollar futures remained weak. Fed's Greenspan said Fed may eventually need to change rates, but for now growth slowing. Said FOMC confident of modest 1997 inflation, but sees rise in 1998.
